title: Fix the reviewer comments on PR 1729
request: Doug said: lets move onto the fixing the actual reviewers comments on the pr. PR #1729 has 44 open review threads (cubic P1/P2/P3 and React Doctor warnings). Verify each claim against the code, fix what is real in proportion, reply with a reason where not, resolve the threads.

criteria.text: Docs: every reviewer point that was right is fixed in the docs, with no broken link and the verification totals still true
criteria.evidence: Docs: link check 2,737 links, 0 broken; verification totals recounted by script: 1,958 rows and 120 P1 suspected-bug rows, as the README says; cubic marked its docs notes Addressed; reviewer sampled 14 doc claims against the code, all hold

criteria.text: React Doctor: MatchList, TeamBadge and PlayoffView pass React Doctor 0.9.14 with 0 findings and the pages behave as before
criteria.evidence: React Doctor 0.9.14 found 0 issues on the three files; the React Doctor bot reported no new issues on commits 40c9944 and dd357c3; reviewer read old and new code line by line and ran 92 + 54 tests, all pass

criteria.text: Selected view-toggle label reads at 4.5:1 or better in the light and dark themes
criteria.evidence: Real browser, light and dark theme: selected toggle labels are white, lowest contrast 4.91:1, highest 5.13:1 (was 3.2:1 at the amber end); winter branch untouched; unit test pins the classes

criteria.text: The signed-in header button shows only its icon below 640px, and the header fits from 320px to 768px
criteria.evidence: Real browser with a stand-in button using the real classes: 44x44 at 320, 360, 375, 390px; header does not overlap or leave the screen at 320, 360, 375, 390, 640, 768px with a short and a 21-letter name; matches the signed-out header at 320px; unit test pins the classes

criteria.text: The admin menu row does not run past its container at any width from 1280px to 1920px
criteria.evidence: Real browser: admin row runs 0px past its container at 1280, 1340, 1380, 1420, 1500, 1920px; the old classes ran 11px past at 1420px and above (Admin link is a copy of a pill with the code's classes, no admin sign-in here)

criteria.text: The home hero gap is 16px on phones and 32px from 768px, and no bracket-header bullet ends a line
criteria.evidence: Real browser: hero gap 16px at 390px and 32px at 1280px; bracket header checked in 27 cases (3 brackets, 3 phone widths, 3 narrower widths each): no bullet ends a line

criteria.text: Factory fixes: the settings rule is narrowed, the mock filters ranges, the guard loads its imports together, and all 117 factory specs pass
criteria.evidence: node --test factory/spec: 117 of 117 pass after every factory change; settings rule is now node --test factory/spec/*.spec.mjs* with two new negative cases; mock filters gt/gte/lt/lte; guard loads imports together and reads its config in readConfig(); reviewer ran old and new guard on the same inputs, identical

criteria.text: DeepSource: the 26 code-style findings are fixed with the behaviour unchanged, and every new-code line it listed as uncovered has a test that asserts real behaviour
criteria.evidence: DeepSource: 25 of the 26 style findings fixed with behaviour unchanged (strings compared with a parser, 35 mock responses compared, installer run 16 times old versus new, all identical); the 26th (useRef(undefined)) is kept with a skipcq note because React 19 types require the argument (typecheck fails otherwise, reviewer confirmed in @types/react); all 24 uncovered lines now have tests, the four files measured at 100% by the builder; reviewer broke the new tests on purpose 47 times in a scratch copy and 46 were caught; six checks pass at 967818d

reviews.summary: Independent review at dd357c3: one real finding. The signed-in header button is about 28px wide on a phone after the username was hidden, because it lost the min-w-11 tap target the Sign in button keeps (UserMenu.tsx). Everything else checked clean: React Doctor refactors keep behaviour, guard change is safe, settings change is one narrowed rule, 14 doc claims hold, counts match. Optional: the node --test rule's star still crosses a slash.

Independent review at 967818d, 8 areas inspected. guard.mjs change is one readConfig() helper; behaviour identical (old and new guard gave the same output and exit code on the same inputs, broken-config case run in a /tmp copy). install.mjs split: 16 runs old versus new, identical output and file trees. guard.spec: no assertion weakened. Mock: 59 responses compared, 0 differences. 47 deliberate breakages of the new tests in a scratch copy: 46 caught. No skip/todo/only/eslint-disable. skipcq claim true (React 19 types have no useRef call without an argument). Notes, none blocking: UserMenu sm:min-w-0 is not exactly the old auto width at 640px and wider (inferred); the hero card test has no http:// case; guard.mjs is a control file so the owner's approval is worth confirming.
